張晏誠教授目前為國立臺灣大學管理學院財務金融學系專任教授,同時為國立臺灣大學學術勵進青年講座、管理學院陳鴻謨先生講座及國際政經學院永豐金融講座。自美國華盛頓大學(福斯特商學院)取得財務金融博士學位後,先後於上海高級金融學院及國立臺灣大學財務金融學系擔任助理教授、副教授及教授。張教授的研究興趣廣泛,包括行為財務學及實證因果推論於財務、會計及經濟領域之應用,研究成果曾發表於頂尖期刊Journal of Finance、Review of Financial Studies (x2)、The Accounting Review、Contemporary Accounting Research及學術會議American Finance Association、Western Finance Association、European Finance Association, NBER等,議題包括股價指數、投資人意見分歧、社會多元性、訊息揭露、公司治理等。學術方面,張晏誠教授曾獲得國科會傑出研究獎、玉山學術獎、臺大學術著作傑出獎、現任財務金融學刊副主編、臺灣財務金融學會理事、多次擔任國內外學術會議及期刊之審查委員。教學方面,亦曾獲的臺大校教學傑出獎(全英語)、臺大校教學優良(x3)、管理學院教學優良(x6)。
research_interests_en: • Behavioral Finance • Asset Pricing • Corporate Finance

Yen-Cheng Chang is the University Excelsior Chair, College of Management Chen Hong-Mo Chair, and Professor of Finance at National Taiwan University (NTU). He is also the SinoPac Financial Holdings Professor in the School of Political Science and Economics (SPE) at NTU. Previously, he was an assistant professor at the Shanghai Advanced Institute of Finance. His research interests include behavioral finance and econometric identification across finance, accounting, and economics, with publications in leading journals including the Journal of Finance, Review of Financial Studies (x2), The Accounting Review, and the Contemporary Accounting Research. Professor Chang is an Associate Editor at the Journal of Financial Studies and a Director of the Taiwan Finance Association. His research has received the NSTC Outstanding Research Award, E.Sun Academic Awards, NTU Distinguished Academic Publications Award, among others. For his teaching, he has received the NTU Distinguished Teaching Award, NTU Outstanding Teaching Award (x3), and NTU College of Management Outstanding Teaching Award (x6).
